label: Requirement 2 completed across ALL SIX screen sizes before any mechanism is written off, because eligibility was shown to be size dependent. Seed 4, 300 s, 50:50, dry run, decisions differing from builder-default.
findings: SIX mechanisms are dead at ALL SIX sizes: s1-feasible, s1-fairshare, s2-all, s2-value, s4-llf, s6-decline. The extra sizes did not rescue any of them, so the write-offs stand on six sizes rather than two.

TWO mechanisms have a SIZE THRESHOLD INSIDE THE CROSSOVER BAND, which the two-size test would have mischaracterised. s4-reserve is inert at 8, barely alive at 10 (3 decisions), climbing through 12 (160) and 14 (1,631) to 16 (3,721). Read only at 16 it looks simply eligible; in fact it switches on exactly where session 2 found the baselines collapse at n=12.
s4-adaptive is inert until 14 (9 decisions) and only clearly live at 16 (173).
s1-lateness is dead at 8 through 16 and live only at 32, the single mechanism whose eligibility the original two-size test established correctly only by luck of including 32.
s3-whatif is live at every size tested and grows monotonically with load, 2,120 at 8 to 4,226 at 16.

n=32 filled: s3-whatif 4,181, s4-reserve 3,922, s4-adaptive 3,876. All three remain eligible at the largest size, and s4-adaptive shows the sharpest threshold of any mechanism, 0, 0, 0, 9, 173, 3,876 across the six sizes.

classified_nulls.builder-s1-feasible: UNEXERCISED at every size. Counters fire, 8,039 streams held at 32, while zero decisions differ: every held stream had no instant due, and a local StreamAction only matters when one is pending.

classified_nulls.builder-s2-all: UNEXERCISED at every size. Every recall is already feasible under the default, so admitting all coincides with admitting the feasible.
classified_nulls.builder-s2-value: UNEXERCISED at every size, MATCHING THE PRE-REGISTERED EXPECTATION recorded before the measurement.
classified_nulls.builder-s4-llf: CANCELLED BY GEOMETRY at every size. Laxity reorders candidates; with no binding release budget nothing is truncated, so order cannot change which streams are released.
classified_nulls.builder-s6-decline: UNEXERCISED at every size. No REJECT arises under the default, so the branch never executes.

proofs_that_passed_for_the_wrong_reason.note: two in one night, recorded together because the lesson is the same: a byte-identity proof is evidence only when every input it depends on is compared explicitly, and both were caught by checking the proof internals rather than its verdict.
proofs_that_passed_for_the_wrong_reason.mine: the S2 admission estimate was LlfArms S_hat rather than B7s, and the proof still passed because every query was feasible under either estimate. Equivalence by REGIME COINCIDENCE.
proofs_that_passed_for_the_wrong_reason.session1: its wrapper omitted uses_h and the proof passed because False is the getattr default and happened to match the base. Equivalence by DEFAULT COINCIDENCE.
